mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the cold vessel response with shivering was most worthwhile: one reduces heat loss, while the other makes heat.

leastWorthwhile.text: Starting the warm and cold sequences by combining the body with the weather felt fairly predictable, though it made the change in conditions clear.

surprise.text: I expected warming to lead straight to the sweat glands, but the compatibility hint first directed me to skin vessels and showed increased blood flow near the surface.

arbitrary.text: The required vessel step before sweating was not obvious to me. The result explained its role, but not why it had to come first in this sequence.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter: connecting familiar responses like sweating and shivering to heat movement was interesting, even if some steps were predictable.
